verdicts.reason: A shrinks every element into a tall canvas: the left-aligned headline clashes with the centred body and dashes, there are huge dead gaps between the blocks, and the booking line is tiny and hard to read. B fills the format and keeps the text readable, but its alignment is muddled (headline and teal line start at different left edges while the body is centred), and the booking/website copy is set nearly as large as the main message, which flattens the hierarchy and crams the bottom half.
